orientation.evidence: Public episode 41 frames 0/149: decoded upright; extra 180 worsens calibrated epipolar residual
orientation.scope: sampled public streams only; verify each new source's decode/preprocessing history

camera_frame.status: project adopted interpretation of Perspective calibration
camera_frame.transforms: A_T_B maps column-vector B coordinates to A; translations in meters

stereo.rectification: recompute using full K,D and left_to_right R,t; never reuse stored rectification rotations without closure/image checks
stereo.metric_depth: use Q or P matrices generated in the same stereoRectify call; do not mix nominal baseline with calibrated P/Q

distortion.model: Perspective rational polynomial plus thin-prism and tilt
distortion.after_undistortion: record output K or stereo P, output size/crop and zero-distortion state; do not undistort twice

pixel_coordinates.intrinsics: K'=H*K if optical coordinates retained; negative focal values after180 are intentional, not canonical OpenCV K
pixel_coordinates.positive_focal_rotated_basis: S=diag(-1,-1,1); K'=H*K*S; A'_T_B'=S4*A_T_B*S4; full distortion handling must change consistently

pairing.policy: Use exact frame index per released README; validate counts/PTS and preserve all clocks separately
pairing.tolerance_status: engineering serialization tolerance only; not a physical exposure guarantee
pairing.cross_device_note: Separate rigs are explicitly not hardware synchronized; these skew figures are not within-ego RGB/stereo lag estimates
pairing.timebase_policy: Never align parquet timestamp to video PTS by nearest time or rescale implicitly; use frame identity and retain original clocks

object_poses.invalid: visible=false means all-zero pose; zero quaternion is not a rotation
object_poses.world_origin: x/y centered independently per episode; offsets not provided; z is not centered
